name: ai.lrrk/agent-desk
title: LrrK Agent Desk
description: Read-only tools for cited LrrK evidence, weekly publication changes, and reviewed service referrals.

tools.name: lrrk_check_updates
tools.description: Get exact record additions, corrections, and withdrawals between saved published version keys and the current public versions. Corrections identify verified changes to public fields where historical detail exists. Withdrawals link to a persistent public notice for the comparison. Follow nextPage with the same knownVersions before saving the new keys. An unknown checkpoint or unavailable source means the exact comparison is incomplete.

knownVersions.description: Version keys from an earlier response. Omit on the first check.

changePage.description: Copy a source's nextPage exactly and keep the original knownVersions.

tools.name: lrrk_find_evidence
tools.description: Search published LrrK Letters, reviewed Hardware Attack Library records, and admitted Intelligence Product metadata. Returns bounded excerpts and canonical source links. Historical paid publication bodies are never returned.

tools.name: lrrk_get_evidence
tools.description: Retrieve the metadata, edition, citations, evidence status and limits for one public LrrK record. Request a Letter footnote by its printed number, or pass nextCitationPage as citationPage with the same kind and id. Use the returned revision to pin a later lookup. Historical Intelligence Products expose public metadata and their owner handoff only.

footnote.description: Exact numbered footnote in a Letter. Use without citationPage.

revision.description: Expected record revision. A mismatch returns no citations.

citationPage.description: Copy nextCitationPage exactly. Omit to start at the first citation.

tools.name: lrrk_map_coverage
tools.description: Find published references about a topic. With a device class, match its phrase in HAL titles or device fields, public Letters, and Intelligence titles, products or tags before ranking up to eight results. Each source reports its verified match count or unavailable. A mention does not establish device applicability.

tools.name: lrrk_find_service
tools.description: Find LrrK's human-reviewed Assess, Engage, Monitor, or one-question Evidence Brief path for a stated need. Returns criteria and a first-party link; no inquiry is submitted and no work is initiated.
